scope: Open abstract of the ATS/JRS LAM guideline. The PMC XML has no recommendation body, so only statements in the abstract are used.

keyRecommendations.text: LAM is a rare cystic lung disease that primarily affects women.
The guideline recommends sirolimus and VEGF-D testing.
The guideline recommends against doxycycline and against hormonal therapy.

clinicalBottomLine: LAM is a rare cystic lung disease of women. This abstract supports sirolimus and VEGF-D testing, and recommends against doxycycline and hormonal therapy. Doses and VEGF-D cutoffs are not in the open text.
notableCaveats: Full recommendation text, doses, and thresholds are not in the PMC XML.

source.title: Official American Thoracic Society/Japanese Respiratory Society Clinical Practice Guidelines: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis Diagnosis and Management.
